questions.question: Identity paging proves what?
questions.explanation: Map first, isolate later: machinery before policy.

questions.question: PIC remapped because?
options: Default IRQ0 collides with CPU faults (vector 8)
questions.explanation: IBM 1981 overlap: every OS remaps to 0x20.

questions.question: iret vs ret?
options: iret pops eip+cs+eflags (interrupts resume; ret would deafen)
questions.explanation: Full resume: the tick must return the machine whole.

questions.question: tasks proves switching how?
options: Two esp values 4K apart + spins growing between calls
questions.explanation: Evidence: distinct stacks, motion without prompting.

questions.question: The switch is honestly?
options: Timer-flagged, cooperatively executed (yield at loop top)
questions.explanation: Timer contests, shell yields: hybrid, labeled.

questions.question: dispatch table is?
options: Syscalls minus the trap (same shape, no rings yet)
questions.explanation: Name->function dispatch: syscall table's civilian cousin.
